crossRefs.note: God, you are my God. I will earnestly seek you. My soul thirsts for you. My flesh longs for you, in a dry and weary…
My soul longs, and even faints for the courts of Yahweh. My heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.
My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word.
My eyes fail for your word. I say, “When will you comfort me?”
Behold, he will kill me. I have no hope. Nevertheless, I will maintain my ways before him.
We are pressed on every side, yet not crushed; perplexed, yet not to despair;
Therefore we don’t faint, but though our outward man is decaying, yet our inward man is renewed day by day.
For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
For I am already being offered, and the time of my departure has come.
knowing that the putting off of my tent comes swiftly, even as our Lord Jesus Christ made clear to me.
Yahweh is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my…
Wait for Yahweh. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for Yahweh.
In the day that I called, you answered me. You encouraged me with strength in my soul.
He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might.
He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I…
Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, and in distresses, for Christ’s…
Yahweh assigned my portion and my cup. You made my lot secure.
The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places. Yes, I have a good inheritance.
Yahweh is my portion. I promised to obey your words.
I cried to you, Yahweh. I said, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”
“Yahweh is my portion,” says my soul. “Therefore I will hope in him.”
I heard a loud voice out of heaven saying, “Behold, God’s dwelling is with people, and he will dwell with them, and…
He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor…
He who overcomes, I will give him these things. I will be his God, and he will be my son.

translations.web: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
translations.bsb: My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
translations.kjv: My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.
translations.asv: My flesh and my heart faileth; But God is the strength of my heart and my portion for ever.
